title: resc implemented MCP tool catalog
description: Generated from current tools/list. See docs/engine-capabilities.md. All MCP LBAs use the session sector_size (512 or 4096).

tools.description: Enumerate Windows physical drives (read-only); up to eight samples, explicit errors if unavailable.
tools.name: list_physical_drives

tools.description: Open a source image or supported device read-only. Every LBA uses the session sector_size (512 or 4096). A durable WAL is restored with resume_session_id. Source-device exports require destination isolation and currently return NotImplemented.

resume_session_id.description: Reopen an image session and replay its WAL

tools.name: open_recovery_session

tools.description: Validate MBR partition bounds, both GPT header CRC32s, array CRC32s and partition bounds. Return compact partition samples.
tools.name: scan_disk_topology

tools.description: Read-only triage of MBR/GPT, sampled NTFS/FAT32 boot geometry, exFAT/BitLocker markers and entropy; recommends multiple recovery routes without applying patches. Samples do not prove overwrite, encryption, physical health or recoverability.
tools.name: diagnose_recovery

tools.description: Inspect MP4/MOV box bounds and stco/co64 chunk starts through an ordered, non-overlapping byte reconstruction plan. Skips media payload; bounded to 4096 boxes, depth 12 and 65536 chunk offsets. STRUCTURE_CONSISTENT is not decode verification. Fragmented MP4 needs an external demuxer. Does not write source or output.
tools.name: analyze_video_candidate

tools.description: Case 1: compare validated primary/backup GPT and NTFS/FAT32 boot evidence; return bounded overlay-only repair proposals. Does not apply patches or establish file recoverability. Unknown volume identity requires independent confirmation.
tools.name: analyze_partition_recovery

tools.description: Case 3: bounded JPEG marker/PNG CRC structure checks or MP4/MOV box analysis through ordered non-overlapping byte ranges. May identify a candidate terminator length; does not infer unknown fragment order or decode content. AUTO recognizes supported formats only.
tools.name: analyze_file_candidate

tools.description: Read 1..8 sectors through the overlay. Return bounded hex preview or boot/header analysis; boot signatures do not establish mountability.
tools.name: inspect_sector_structure

tools.description: NotImplemented: deleted-record and journal recovery. This tool returns an explicit error.
tools.name: scan_filesystem_journals

tools.description: Run a cancellable background job. FAT32_DELETED_SCAN inspects deleted SFN entries in a FAT32 root directory; params partition_start_lba required, max_clusters default 256 (1..4096). Bounded candidate evidence, not guaranteed undelete. ISO_BMFF_BOX_SCAN finds plausible ftyp/moov/mdat/moof headers with declared lengths; hits are not validated files or proven fragment matches. SIMD jobs accept start_lba/end_lba (exclusive) or count_sectors. DD_RESCUE_CLONE requires destination_image and optional mapfile; uses native block copying, no resume. FRAGMENT_PREFILTER requires first_fragment_end_lba; optional candidate_start_lba/candidate_end_lba/cluster_sectors. Fragment scores are heuristics, not format validation. Poll returns counts and bounded samples.
tools.name: start_async_disk_job

tools.description: Poll compact progress/result. Set cancel=true to request cooperative cancellation; wait for Cancelled acknowledgement.
tools.name: poll_async_job

tools.description: Read persisted JSONL hits without rescanning. cursor is a byte offset returned by next_cursor. A page stops at the JSON budget even if limit is larger.
tools.name: read_scan_hits

tools.description: Apply checked virtual patches backed by the session WAL. SUCCESS requires native NTFS/FAT root-index traversal and a valid file entry. Specify partition_start_lba for an orphaned volume. UNVERIFIED means patches remain applied but filesystem validation failed.
tools.name: virtual_patch_and_verify

tools.description: Starts a DATA_EXTRACTION job immediately; poll_async_job reports bytes_written and accepts cancellation. Each output has a SHA-256 provenance manifest, staged before data publication. Exclusive output creation, no overwrite. CARVE_BY_BYTE_RANGES params: ranges [{source_byte_offset,length_bytes}] in output order, optional filename; no overlap, no inferred fragment order or format validation. CARVE_BY_LBA_RANGES params: ranges [{start_lba,count}], optional filename. TSK_TREE_EXTRACT uses native parsers through RAM, params: {partition_start_lba}; exports allocated user files recursively, not deleted records or alternate streams. Tree quotas: 10000 files, 8 GiB, depth 64; errors preserve completed files, remove current incomplete file.
tools.name: extract_recovered_data

tools.description: Legacy alias: open an image/device and validate partition structures.
tools.name: disk_scan_partitions

tools.description: Legacy alias: inspect NTFS boot parameters at partition_lba.
tools.name: disk_read_boot_sector

tools.description: Legacy alias for checked RAM byte patches.
tools.name: disk_apply_patch

tools.description: Rollback all patches when rollback_all=true; otherwise undo only the last patch in the default session.
tools.name: disk_rollback_patches
